def factor_cycle_deviation_vol_scaled_v2(df):
    """Shortened window (100-day) cycle deviation normalized by ATR, smoothed with EMA(3), then scaled by volume ratio."""
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    df_copy = df.copy()
    # 100-day SMA
    sma100 = df_copy["close"].rolling(window=100, min_periods=1).mean()
    # True range / ATR
    high, low, close = df_copy["high"], df_copy["low"], df_copy["close"]
    tr1 = high - low
    tr2 = (high - close.shift(1)).abs()
    tr3 = (low - close.shift(1)).abs()
    true_range = pd.concat([tr1, tr2, tr3], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    atr100 = true_range.rolling(window=100, min_periods=1).mean()
    raw = (close - sma100) / atr100.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    # Smooth raw signal with EMA(3)
    raw_smoothed = raw.ewm(span=3, adjust=False).mean()
    # volume scaling
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=100)
    vol_ratio = vol_ratio.fillna(1.0)
    # scale by log(1+vol_ratio) to keep continuous and positive
    scaled = raw_smoothed * np.log1p(vol_ratio)
    df_copy["factor_cycle_deviation_vol_scaled_v2"] = scaled
    return df_copy["factor_cycle_deviation_vol_scaled_v2"]
